name: Omniscience
overview: Scripture reveals God's omniscience as infinite and beyond human comprehension, affirming that His understanding has no limit (Psalms 147:5; Isaiah 40:28). The Lord's knowledge encompasses all things, seeing both the evil and the good everywhere (Proverbs 15:3), and nothing is hidden from His sight—every creature is fully known and exposed before Him (Hebrews 4:13). This divine knowledge extends even to the intimate details of our formation and calling, as God knew Jeremiah before his birth and ordained his prophetic mission (Jeremiah 1:5).
